ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: after ignoring all curved arrows in the figure, it can be seen that the left side is an acyl chloride fragment: the carbonyl carbon is connected to the upper oxygen by a double bond, and is connected to the Cl on the left. This carbonyl carbon is also connected to the central tetrahedral carbon. The central carbon is simultaneously connected to one Cl, one negatively charged O, and the O atom on the right. This O on the right is then connected to the positively charged sulfur atom S+, and the sulfur atom is also connected to two methyl groups. Then reason: the fixed connectivity is the dimethylsulfonium/oxosulfonium side chain C-S+(C)-O-, this O is connected to the central carbon; the central carbon has two branches [O-] and Cl, and is connected to C(=O)Cl. According to the method, start from one methyl group and write C[S+](C)O, then connect the central carbon C([O-])(Cl), and finally connect the acyl chloride C(=O)Cl, obtaining the SMILES.

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure while ignoring all curved arrows. Identify the fixed connectivity: dimethyl sulfonium/sulfoxonium side is CH3-S+(CH3)-O-, where that O is bonded to the central carbon; the central carbon also bears [O-] and Cl and is attached to a carbonyl carbon whose other substituent is Cl. Then construct a valid SMILES by starting at one methyl on sulfur, writing C[S+](C)O for the S+ with two methyl groups and an O linker, attaching that O to the central carbon, and adding the central carbon branches ([O-]) and (Cl), followed by C(=O)Cl. This gives C[S+](C)OC([O-])(Cl)C(=O)Cl.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中忽略所有弯曲箭头后，可见左侧是一个酰氯片段：羰基碳与上方氧双键相连，并与左侧Cl相连。这个羰基碳还与中间的四面体碳相连。中间碳同时连有一个Cl、一个带负电的O，以及右侧的O原子。右侧这个O再连接到带正电的硫原子S+，硫原子还连有两个甲基。再推理：固定连接关系为二甲基硫鎓/氧硫鎓侧链 C-S+(C)-O-，该O连接中间碳；中间碳带有[O-]和Cl两个支链，并连接到C(=O)Cl。按方法从一个甲基开始写作 C[S+](C)O，然后接中心碳 C([O-])(Cl)，最后接酰氯 C(=O)Cl，得到SMILES。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the chemical drawing: a central tetrahedral carbon is bonded to Cl, to an O bearing negative charge, to an O connected to positively charged S with two methyl substituents, and to an acyl chloride carbonyl group C(=O)Cl. Curved arrows in the figure are noted but explicitly ignored.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read the instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression for the transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES syntax for branching and formal charges: positively charged sulfur is written [S+], negatively charged oxygen as [O-], the sulfoxonium fragment as C[S+](C)O-, and the acyl chloride as C(=O)Cl. Encode the central carbon as bonded to O-sulfur fragment, [O-], Cl, and C(=O)Cl without adding or removing atoms implied only by arrows.
